meta.note: Data layer for pitch.aurorapunks.com/portfolio. Steam fields pulled from the public storefront API 2026-09-08. Rights + cloud-fit fields are the Aurora Punks assessment, per aurora_punks/ap_ip_ownership_canonical.md.

titles.name: 1993 Space Machine
titles.cloudnote: The only title in the catalogue with a native Linux build, which is the preferred execution target in every cloud spec we have signed. Full controller support, no online dependency.
titles.hook: A shoot 'em up built for the Amiga 500 in 1992, lost for 23 years, then finished and shipped. Gradius and R-Type lineage, arcade session length.
titles.extra: Also shipped on Switch as 1993 Shenandoah and on PS4. iOS and Android builds exist.

titles.name: Chenso Club
titles.cloudnote: Full EFIGS plus both Chinese scripts, so it drops into most territories without new localisation. Short runs suit a living-room session.
titles.hook: A chainsaw-swinging arena roguelite for one to four players on the couch. Pick a fighter, clear the screen, upgrade, repeat.
titles.extra: Rights reverted from Curve Games to Aurora Punks. The Steam page still credits the old publisher.

titles.name: Block'Em!
titles.cloudnote: The broadest localisation in the catalogue at 13 languages, and the best living-room fit on paper. The one gap is that it ships multiplayer-only, so a single-player mode against AI bots would need building before a solo-subscriber service could carry it.
titles.hook: A block-building party brawl for two to four players. Simple controls, chaotic races. Built for a sofa and four pads.
titles.extra: Rights reverted from Curve Games to Aurora Punks.

titles.name: Ooglians
titles.cloudnote: Full controller support and offline play, but English-only and still in Early Access. Best suited to an English-language territory or a value tier.
titles.hook: Defend your machinery with more machinery, which attracts more Ooglians. A tower defence joke that keeps escalating.

titles.name: IRON EVIL
titles.cloudnote: Not release-ready. Partial controller support only, which would need finishing before any TV or set-top deployment.
titles.hook: A roguelite through a factory owned by an evil corporation. Every part you leave behind gets bolted onto something that hunts you.
titles.extra: Store page live, release date not announced.

titles.name: Distant Bloom
titles.signer: Aurora Punks AB, with developer sign-off
titles.cloudnote: Arguably the best living-room fit we have. Single-player, full controller support including DualShock and DualSense, no online dependency, and a calm pace that reads well on a TV.
titles.hook: Restore a broken alien world by planting it back to life. A serene colony builder about repair rather than conquest.
titles.extra: Aurora Punks holds publishing rights. Streaming licence needs the developer's sign-off.

titles.name: Go Fight Fantastic
titles.signer: Aurora Punks AB, with developer sign-off
titles.cloudnote: Full controller support with DualShock and DualSense profiles, and it plays solo or three-player co-op. Hand-drawn art holds up well under stream compression.
titles.hook: Bird Planet is under attack. A fast, hand-drawn hack and slash for one to three players, solo or in co-op.
titles.extra: Aurora Punks holds publishing rights. Streaming licence needs the developer's sign-off.

titles.name: KreatureKind
titles.signer: Aurora Punks AB, with developer sign-off
titles.cloudnote: Ten languages, single-player, full controller support. Card games are the cheapest genre to stream because the frame rarely moves, which keeps bitrate and technical cost low.
titles.hook: Save magic by debating monsters into joining you. A warm deckbuilder about building a movement rather than an army.
titles.extra: Aurora Punks holds publishing rights. Streaming licence needs the developer's sign-off.

titles.name: Tears of Adria
titles.signer: Ark Island Studio, brokered by Aurora Punks
titles.cloudnote: Strongest review score in the catalogue and a macOS build, but no controller support is declared on the store page. That is the blocker for a TV or set-top deployment and would need confirming with the developer.
titles.hook: A real-time strategy RPG with autobattles. One hero becomes a party, then a dragon problem, then a resurrection you probably should not attempt.
titles.extra: Ark Island IP. Aurora Punks can broker but does not hold the licence.

titles.name: Sir Whoopass: Immortal Death
titles.signer: Atomic Elbow, brokered by Aurora Punks
titles.cloudnote: The largest audience in the portfolio by a wide margin, nine languages, and full controller support with DualShock and DualSense profiles. The most proven single title on this list.
titles.hook: A comedy action RPG that spends its entire runtime mocking serious action RPGs. Nearly 2,000 reviews and Very Positive.
titles.extra: Atomic Elbow IP, separate publishing track. Aurora Punks can introduce and broker.

titles.name: Robot Lord Rising
titles.cloudnote: Unreleased, partial controller support, and the rights position is not settled. Listed for completeness, not currently offered.
titles.hook: A four-player arena brawl driven by action cards and thirty-second panic. Couch or online.
titles.extra: Rights sit with Runatyr AB, not Aurora Punks. Not available to licence until that is resolved.
